verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service platform. A platform like this could plausibly offer AI-generated insights (for example, on transaction or account data), so the axis applies. The evidence covers only API features: accounts, KYC, payments, cards and webhooks. None of it shows AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The llms.txt probe concerns documentation for LLMs, not in-product AI insights.
